general_information.name: OH—MY FULL LEGAL NAME? I MEAN, I’VE GOT MY NAME, BUT I’M NOT SURE IF YOU WANT THE WHOLE FORMAL VERSION WITH THE MIDDLE BITS OR JUST HOW IT’S ON THE PAPERS. I ALWAYS GET TANGLED UP WITH THAT KIND OF THING. I CAN GIVE YOU THE REST IF YOU WANT, BUT I’M NOT SURE WHAT EXACTLY YOU MEAN BY “LEGAL DOCUMENTS.”

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s mostly the waves of sadness, really. I miss my wife a lot since she died… it’s been about a year, from cancer, and some days it just comes over me, especially around anniversaries and things like that. But I’m still working, I’m sleeping reasonably, eating okay, and I do still see friends, so… it’s not like I’ve fallen apart or anything, just, you know, carrying it around.
current_concerns.goals: Mostly just to learn how to live with the loss, I suppose. Keep going the way she would have wanted me to… and not get stuck in it.

past_psychiatric_history.previous_therapies: Yes — I went to a bereavement group. It was through hospice, I think. That was in 2025, and there were about 8 sessions, if I’m remembering right… or that’s what they told me.; 2025.; About 8 sessions.

medical_history.medical_conditions: High cholesterol. I was told that back in 2016.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born in Cork, and then we moved to Toronto when I was 8. It was a warm family, really. That’s about all I can say—nothing dramatic that I know of.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I finished an engineering degree, and honestly there weren’t any major difficulties that I can think of. It was pretty straightforward, I suppose.
personal_history.significant_relationships: Well, I was married — widowed now. It was 33 years, my wife and I. She died from cancer about a year ago. And I’ve got two adult children nearby, if that matters… they’re around.
personal_history.future_goals: I’d like to keep working, see my grandchildren, and maybe travel a little. Just… keep going, really.
